messages:
ajay: quick proposal — add an API key prefix that encodes routing target so the edge proxy can route to hosted / dedicated / private without a DB hit. sketch: D_<key> for Dedicated, H_<key> hosted, P_<key> private. low-risk opt-in migration.
sam: leaking deployment type in the key itself worries me (info leak + attacker enumeration).
claire: main upside is avoiding a synchronous lookup on the hot path. latency drop and fewer tx to auth service for high-qps customers.
ajay: agreed on privacy concern. prefix is only a routing hint; authn/authz still validate tenant and key lifetime. we can also HMAC-sign the prefix if needed.
maya: billing/metrics mapping becomes much simpler if we can route early. rotation: how will rotation work across formats? ephemeral tokens complicate this.
sam: migration plan + SDK changes will be painful. need to support both formats for a long time.
ajay: proposed rollout: (1) accept new-prefixed keys at proxy (routing only), (2) auth service validates full key as usual, (3) expose dashboard flag and allow customer to opt-in, (4) deprecate old-only keys after 6 months. fallback to old path if prefix not present.
claire: important: prefix must NOT change RBAC semantics. tenant/org/project scoping remains derived from the key's claims or server-side mapping. prefix only chooses where to route the request.
ajay: yes. authz layer will ignore prefix for permission checks. we'll add explicit tests asserting that.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: proxy-config-2026-05-12 (id: 9876) — will add routing map stage behind feature flag.
sam: can we do a simple nginx map as a first PoC? here's a quick example:
```
map $http_x_api_key $route {
  default backend_hosted;
  ~^D_ backend_dedicated;
  ~^H_ backend_hosted;
  ~^P_ backend_private;
}
proxy_pass http://$route;
```
claire: add telemetry: mark requests that took routing-hint path vs lookup path so we can measure correctness and perf.
maya: I'll draft the migration doc and include examples for customer-generated keys vs server-issued keys. can own rollout comms.
ajay: thanks — I'll open an RFC with opt-in timeline, security analysis (info-leak risk + HMAC option), and the test plan. will ping product and infra for slot. :thumbsup:

sam: one more thought — if attackers can enumerate prefixes, we should rate-limit unknown-key prefix lookups at the edge to avoid mass scanning. keep an allowlist for private prefixes to avoid exposing internal-only deployments.
claire: good call. add a metric for unknown-prefix spikes and an alert during the opt-in window.
ajay: agreed. action items: ajay -> RFC, maya -> migration doc + comms, claire -> telemetry/alerts, sam -> rate-limit rules PoC.

maya: ack.

ajay: wrapping up — thanks all.
